steps.note: the API built this case's state
Configure the event as an RFQ rather than the default auction.
Apply the first available RFQ pricing template.
Add the single line item needed for the bid.
Set and commit a live bidding window.
Invite the QA vendor who will submit the bid.
Open the supplier session for the invited vendor.
Open the RFQ pricing round in the vendor portal.
Submit the vendor's bid; the catalog can verify the bid price but not a separate freight component or deadline offset.
Confirm the vendor portal shows the bid as submitted.
Return to the buyer's event page immediately after submission.
Open the buyer's Master QCS to inspect the new bid and ranking.
Verify the submitted vendor appears as a real vendor column.
Verify the submitted bid is ranked L1 for the available single-vendor state.
Verify QCS ranks follow the RFQ amount ordering.
